tolerance_note: Practical review tolerance, not a statistical confidence interval. Confirm spatial alignment before treating timing as final.
clock_transition_method: Reviewed source frames: old digit at t=n+0.16; next second at t=n+0.20, for n=0 through 11. Midpoint used. Assumes displayed clock increments on whole seconds.
source_frame_mapping_method: Decoded-frame MD5 matches original 25fps frames to frames selected by ffmpeg fps=10. Source time differs slightly from 10fps playback time.
limitations: Broadcast clock and SkillCorner action labels do not agree exactly; event-checked offset used for tracking alignment.
Possession end labels and smoothed ball trajectories limit sub-frame timing precision.
No player identity mapping or spatial calibration has been performed.
